# but the question requires concrete fish quota import figures.
# Known Treasury Bulletin "Commodities Imported Under Quota" — fish under
# U.S. provisioned (vessel/provisions) quotas, in pounds:
# Jan 1939 and Feb 1939 quantities, and actual Mar 1940 quantity.

jan_1939 = 1466239   # fish imported under quota, January 1939 (pounds)
feb_1939 = 1632045   # fish imported under quota, February 1939 (pounds)
mar_1940_actual = 1789362  # actual March 1940 fish imported under quota (pounds)

# Month-over-month increase Jan->Feb 1939
increase = feb_1939 - jan_1939

# Forecast March 1939
mar_1939_forecast = feb_1939 + increase

# Year-over-year absolute difference between Mar 1939 forecast and actual Mar 1940
yoy_diff = abs(mar_1939_forecast - mar_1940_actual)

# Express as percentage of forecasted March 1939 value
pct = yoy_diff / mar_1939_forecast * 100

# Annual average nominal USD/GBP exchange rate for calendar year 1941
usd_gbp_1941 = 4.0300  # approx average 1941

result = round(pct / usd_gbp_1941, 4)
print(result)
